path.id: A winding line, a familiar taste.
The selected structure is the continuous red-bean filling wound through the roll. The final symbol keeps that path as one open spiral.
The workbook records Manchu and Qing-court associations, everyday snacking and festival occasions. The Cixi naming story is treated as a legend.
